expected.raw_text: Du kennst grundlegende ML-Verfahren, Modelltraining und Evaluation

parsed.seniority_signal: Idealerweise hast du bereits 3–5 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, im AI Engineering oder Machine Learning gearbeitet.
parsed.degree_signal: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Bereich ist willkommen – ebenso eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch Praxiserfahrung.
parsed.notes:
Only Überzeugende Voraussetzungen supplies candidate qualifications; responsibilities and benefits do not independently supply skills.
The two explicit oder lists are treated as alternatives; comparable technologies add no further skill.
Generative AI and Large Language Models collapse to llms.
Deployment and reliable production operation explicitly concern good software development; on a literal reading they are not specifically model deployment or MLOps and remain unmapped.
The degree wording ist willkommen is interpreted as optional, but this marker is not explicitly covered by the guide and is flagged for review.
The preferred 3–5 years supplies the inferred mid-level signal; AI Engineering in that experience clause is treated as a work area rather than a separate technical skill.
